annotations.title: Test an email-reading rule (hack) on example messages

description: Shows what a hack template reads from example messages, without saving anything. Templates are the message's fixed text with {{field:type}} where values go (types: text, number, currency, date, datetime, boolean, url), {{...}} for parts that change but aren't wanted, {{#each}}...{{/each}} around a repeating list, and {{or}} on its own line between wordings of the same kind of message. A json template is an example JSON body with values replaced by {{field:type}}.

parser.description: text for emails (the default), json for webhook bodies.
